description: This file defines the class MenuLinkDefaultForm, which provides an administrative form for editing static menu links in Drupal. It includes methods for building the form, extracting form values, and submitting updates to menu link definitions.

classes.name: MenuLinkDefaultForm
classes.description: A form class for editing Drupal menu links, implementing MenuLinkFormInterface and ContainerInjectionInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies such as menu link manager, parent selector, string translation, module handler, and optionally module extension list.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the class from a container.

methods.name: setMenuLinkInstance
methods.description: Sets the menu link instance to be edited.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds the form for editing a menu link, including title, provider info, link, enabled/expanded checkboxes, parent selection, and weight.

methods.name: extractFormValues
methods.description: Extracts and returns the updated menu link definition from form input.

methods.name: submitConfigurationForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, updating the menu link definition via the menu link manager.
